limitations: Generations are execution recovery namespaces, never independent extra seeds.
Snapshot files read once during stated interval; not an atomic filesystem transaction.
RQ3 first completed prediction retained independent of score; otherwise latest observed terminal retained while newer pending remains explicitly marked.
RQ3 mixes retained V10/V11 earlier turn limits and V12 500-turn attempts; it is not an all-500-turn experiment.
Conditional mean/std are three repeat accuracy rates over available valid outcomes; pending, unknown timeouts and ungraded completions are not zero-filled.
System/not-started failures are missing/excluded under the current grader; only explicit task budget exhaustion scores zero.
Grading progress is highly unequal across resolution cells; partial conditional scores cannot establish resolution rankings.
